Thanks for the pull request. Every pull request must link an approved issue, and this pull request does not link one, so it was closed.

To continue:

1. Find or open an issue for the change
2. Wait for a maintainer to add the `ready-for-pr` label
3. Add `Closes #<issue number>` to the pull request body, and ask a maintainer to reopen the pull request

See [How do changes get made to Plotly.js?](https://github.com/plotly/plotly.js/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#how-do-changes-get-made-to-plotlyjs)
